publication_policy.effect: Upstream evidence selects foundation components. Installation, client wiring and organic-use evidence remain separate; the unrun comparative evaluations recorded below are evidence limits, not selection gates. This review changes no installed selection or historical trial artifact.

method: Authenticated read-only GitHub discovery found 366 starred repositories; 56 matched memory/retrieval-related names, descriptions or topics.
Reviewed selected upstream source at the recorded commit, release metadata, test workflows, hosted CI observations, benchmark disclosures, license boundaries and documented integrations.
Repository quality is an engineering judgment by role, not a numeric benchmark ranking. Source-file presence alone is not a passing test.
Three reviewers owned separate memory, document-RAG and coding-context scopes; a completeness critic checked the proposed composition. This was not a blind or cross-family convergence experiment.
source_scope: 18 reviewed repositories: 15 in the observed star inventory plus Docling, Haystack and Qdrant. This is a bounded shortlist, not an exhaustive global search.

strengths: Retain/recall/reflect; semantic, BM25, graph and temporal retrieval with reranking.
API, real-model, SDK, integration and deployment workflows; public evaluation harness.
observations: The latest retrieved successful core CI was dated September 29 on an earlier revision, not the reviewed head.
Reviewed-head AMB jobs failed for missing Groq credentials; the overall performance run was in progress. This is not an accuracy-threshold failure.
Published mutable latest-image vulnerability scans failed while fresh-main image scans passed; neither establishes the status of a pinned stable image digest.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Vendor-authored harness publishes datasets, prompts, models, baselines and outputs; no matched local comparative run was executed.

strengths: Layout, reading order, tables, OCR and structured document representation.
Regression ground-truth fixtures, core and ML/OCR test lanes, and documented Haystack integration.
observations: Reviewed-head CI had 10 successful, 4 skipped and 3 in-progress checks at observation; no failure was observed in that snapshot.
The preceding Run CI Main at f80a79b08d13cc1c9f37106e9aaf689cf9f76e4f succeeded.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Parser features and regression coverage do not establish extraction accuracy on the user's corpus.

strengths: Explicit component pipelines and documented Docling/Qdrant integrations.
Actual Windows, macOS and Linux unit/integration jobs succeeded in the inspected Tests run.
observations: Inspected successful Tests run used 5d298af165ab0e01c1bf5dcada0fe1db9728af1b; it is not proof of testing the reviewed head.
Reviewed-head checks were one success and two skips; workflow path filters can produce successful runs without executing tests.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Framework testing and integration docs do not rank retrieval quality or prove this full composition.

strengths: Dense/sparse retrieval, payload filtering and Haystack hybrid retrieval integration.
Reviewed-head integration jobs passed for single/distributed operation, consensus, consistency and snapshots.
observations: Full check snapshot: 47 success, one cancelled, one failure, one skipped and one in progress.
The observed failure was Dependabot; model testing was in progress. This is not an all-green-head claim.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Database correctness checks are not answer-quality or full-pipeline performance measurements.

strengths: Datasets, traces, custom evaluation and Python/TypeScript integration workflows.
Inspected SDK E2E library tests passed across Python 3.10 through 3.14; Haystack instrumentation is documented.
observations: Reviewed-head check snapshot included 242 success, 8 skipped, 3 failure and 6 cancelled.
One inspected failing metrics job returned 1 failed, 57 passed and 12 skipped: Ragas LangchainLLMWrapper rejected bypass_temperature.
Another OpenAI integration check failed; its root cause was not classified in this review.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Use only evaluated metric integrations; automatic judges are not an independent ground-truth oracle.

strengths: Portable Markdown wiki and derived index, owned handoffs, recovery and native-session integration.
Official multiplatform release artifacts/checksums, cross-platform CI, doctests and deterministic retrieval tests.
observations: Reviewed-head snapshot had 68 successful checks.
Upstream v2.6.0 availability does not upgrade any deployed v2.5.2 selection.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Published local-embedding hit@5 does not establish universal retrieval superiority.

strengths: Code graphs, call tracing, impact analysis and compact local operation.
Official platform artifacts, checksum/signature/SBOM records and platform/ThreadSanitizer CI.
observations: Reviewed-main snapshot had 13 successful checks and one failed publish check.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: The inspected evaluation plan contains no executed scores; a language benchmark is dated v0.3.0. Advertised token savings are not verified whole-task savings.

strengths: Hybrid semantic/keyword search, code/infra artifacts and dependency context.
Unit/integration/E2E suites include real Qdrant/Ollama service tests.
observations: Reviewed-head snapshot had 10 successful checks.
CI's floating Ollama latest image limits reproducibility.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Its additional services and index must earn a distinct semantic role; no measured win over the structural tool was established.

inspected_repositories.release_channel: TypeScript; not a version for all packages
strengths: User/session/agent memory with library, self-hosted server and managed deployment options.
Reviewed-head Python 3.10-3.12 and Node 20/22 CI succeeded.
observations: Managed-platform benchmark optimizations are not all present in the OSS SDK.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Public evaluation code also supports OSS configurations, but managed scores must not be attributed to those configurations.

strengths: OCR/layout/table parsing, inspectable chunks/citations and integrated retrieval.
Actual API integration workflow covers Infinity and Elasticsearch.
observations: Latest release is RC-named despite prerelease=false metadata; it is a substantial Go rewrite.
Reviewed-head tests failed against both backends. Infinity summary: 7 failed, 223 passed, 200 skipped, 2 deselected, 1 xfailed; parsing timeouts appeared.
The failures belong to reviewed Go-era main, not proven failures of v0.27.2; v0.27.2 release acceptance was not verified here.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Capability recommendation has release-transition risk; root cause of the current integration failures remains unclassified.

inspected_repositories.license: MIT core; separate Enterprise License in ee directories
strengths: Application connectors, permission ingestion, indexing workers, agents and MCP access.
Integration, connector, database, browser and MIT/EE CI paths.
observations: Inspected head included failed required aggregators and cancelled browser jobs.
Expanded integration failure showed a Docker Hub token/network timeout while constructing an EE image; it does not demonstrate a retrieval defect.
Lite cannot index documents.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: No release-tag acceptance or comparative retrieval quality was established.

strengths: Hierarchical document trees, reasoning retrieval and page references.
Python/framework/PDFium CI matrix; public PDFs, questions, runner and results for a bounded OSS benchmark.
observations: Reviewed-head checks: 28 success, 2 skipped.
Local OSS handles text PDFs without OCR/image understanding.
The separate PageIndex-OSS-Benchmark repository-root locator is mutable; its reviewed revision was not retained.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Public evaluation selects 62 text-lookup questions over 34 ingestible PDFs and excludes charts, tables, arithmetic and refused documents.

strengths: LightRAG-based text/image/table/equation retrieval with interchangeable document parsers.
Python 3.10-3.12 pytest CI and public reproduction scripts.
observations: Reviewed-head snapshot had six successful checks.
Parser/model integration, first-use downloads and multimedia dependencies remain application responsibilities.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Complete dataset provenance and end-to-end reproduction were not audited.

strengths: Filesystem-scoped context, progressive L0/L1/L2 reads and editable session memory.
Public LoCoMo, LongMemEval and RAG evaluation adapters plus OS/Python test matrix.
observations: Latest retrieved main test checks passed on October 6 at an earlier revision; reviewed head had build/docs success without observed core test checks.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Configurations differ across competitors; this does not prove leaderboard or workload superiority.

inspected_repositories.license: Apache-2.0 core; separately licensed production paths
strengths: Graph/vector/code context, custom ontologies and inspectable retrieval.
Broad backend, OS, MCP and E2E workflows; public benchmark limitations are disclosed.
observations: Reviewed current nightly cloud benchmark and published-image critical-vulnerability scans failed.
Production PostgreSQL graph and small-model extraction have separate licensing boundaries.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: BEAM report discloses same-question tuning at 10M and missing distributed orchestration; no general SOTA claim follows.

strengths: Release gates, test coverage and explicit LongMemEval methodology.
observations: Reviewed-head snapshot had 10 successful checks.
Default tests exclude integration; Windows CI is withheld.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Published 96.6% recall_any@K is retrieval-only with MiniLM, without answer generation or judging; it is not an end-to-end win over Hindsight or Mem0.

strengths: Three-OS tests, coverage gates, backend conformance and official native wheels.
observations: Inspected develop snapshot had nine successful checks.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Disclosures separate raw-Chroma recall from QA accuracy; a 100% figure involved tuning on three errors, with 98.4% held-out reported. These are not matched reasoning-memory comparisons.

strengths: Product integrations and a standalone self-hosted binary offering.
observations: Inspected MCP client defaults to the hosted API.
Reviewed checks: seven success, one failed Workers build, one neutral.
inspected_repositories.benchmark_limit: Reproducible public-source-to-binary core parity was not established, so this review does not award an OSS-core quality lead.

completeness_critic.verdict: Publish final source-review recommendations, not universal SOTA or runtime acceptance.
unresolved: Embedding, sparse-retrieval, reranking and generation model choices and exact model revisions.
Cross-component package locks, deployment configuration and immutable release-image digests.
Representative ingest/retrieve/rerank/generate/cite/evaluate/remember lifecycle, latency, recovery and complete cost.
Independent matched comparative evaluation; vendor benchmark methodologies differ.
next_landscape_sweep_inputs: Review model-layer releases, relevant published results and supported integrations; reserve corpus-level evaluation for separately scoped application behavior.
Assess permission propagation and citation provenance across the complete document pipeline.
Revisit changed release/CI evidence without treating later fixes as erasing the retained failure snapshots.
